description: List the org's spec templates — named, reusable production configurations that can be applied to items via apply_spec_fill(templateId=...). Paged: pass limit (1–100) with offset; omit limit for every template up to 100, or PAGING_REQUIRED. While hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset.

limit.description: Page size (1–100). Omit for every row up to 100, else PAGING_REQUIRED.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; requires limit when nonzero.

name: list_spec_templates
title: List Spec Templates
